atomic_facts.fact: The Lego Group's official legal name is LEGO System A/S
LEGO System A/S is registered in Denmark under the Danish CVR (no. 47458714)
The Lego Group's Danish CVR number is 47458714
The address registered for LEGO System A/S (CVR 47458714) is Aastvej 1, 7190 Billund, Denmark
Aastvej 1, 7190 Billund, Denmark is the Lego Group's headquarters address
The Lego Group's headquarters is located in Billund, Denmark
The headquarters was still in Billund, Denmark as of 2026, consistent with the as-of date 2026-10-01
largestcompanies.com lists LEGO System A/S's address as Åstvej 1, DK-7190 Billund, Denmark
largestcompanies.com ties this address to the company's Danish registry identifiers (VAT No DK47458714, CFAR 1001897135)
largestcompanies.com is an independent third-party source rather than the Lego Group's own website
